items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: Sonny Hendry had Alvin Warren and all the regular record band.

ctx.x: That was his funeral, was it?

No, no. It was a record Jolly Boy parade. See, the Eastern Street, the other side, they call that Simon Boulevard. And we started walking through all the way up past the new railroad station. And the band not playing. You know, the band stopped playing. The minute we got to the canal and Basin Street, all that was beating Cadians on the snare, everybody walking. He wouldn't play. No, he wouldn't play. We didn't play all through that section. Just playing Cadians, people walking in the street. I beat Cadians on…
Yeah, I played the Tuxedo bands.
